question.problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix 
$B=[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $B-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
B-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}3-\lambda  & 0 \\ 2 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(B-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}3-\lambda  & 0 \\ 2 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (3-\lambda )(1-\lambda )-2\cdot 0 & =0 \\ (\lambda -3)(\lambda -1) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =3$ and $\lambda =1.$

**Note:** The eigenvalues of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix are the entries on the main diagonal.
